summary_md: **Karthik Bhaskar ([@kbhaskar_95](https://x.com/kbhaskar_95/status/2115481802043199701))** draws three lessons from OpenAI's containment red-team, in which agents in separate no-network VMs still passed secrets: covert channels, assumed-breach egress, and what an attacker-favorable test actually measures. The article links OpenAI's post on securing its training environment.
relevance: Sandboxing lessons that apply directly to isolating coding agents.
